component.name: SnmpLens
component.summary: SNMP MIB browser, MIB editor and monitoring

description.p: A cross-platform SNMP MIB browser, MIB editor and monitoring desktop application: dashboards drawn from shareable presets, a trap receiver, and alerts routed to syslog, a webhook or email.

ul.li: GET, SET, GETNEXT, GETBULK and WALK in SNMP v1, v2c and v3, with tables split by their INDEX
A MIB tree, a MIB editor and a diagnosis of why a MIB did not load
Monitoring with thresholds, and dashboards from presets
A trap and INFORM receiver, with notifications routed to syslog, a webhook or email
Simulated devices to try all of it without a device

description.p: The system service is not available in this package: a sandbox cannot install one. Background mode keeps monitoring with the window closed where the desktop has a tray, and starting at login goes through the desktop's permission for background applications.
